name: walleterm tunnel live testnet acceptance
setup: walleterm tunnel --port 8797 and walleterm demo --port 8798, each behind its own Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. The browser typed the tunnel URL and eight-digit code.

checks.key_selection: passed; the picker also listed an unrelated SSH key (see issue 1)
checks.multiple_offers_allowed: passed; offer 826627 was created while offer 826443 was open
checks.terminal_denial: passed; no signature, hash not on ledger
checks.1password_agent_error: observed; the first payment attempt failed with 'The agent returned a truncated frame' while 1Password was not ready. The bridge withheld the result and logged it. The demo showed failed. No signature reached the site.

not_tested: pagehide keepalive cancel on iPhone Safari
Friendbot funding of a new account
tunnel restart during an open request

phone_run.device: real iPhone, Safari, controlled through macOS iPhone Mirroring
phone_run.revision: 3bf7810 for the first steps; the typeahead fix for the last note and denials
phone_run.setup: walleterm tunnel --port 8797 and walleterm demo --port 8798 over public Quick Tunnels

checks.qr_scan_with_phone_camera: passed; the owner scanned the tunnel payload with the demo's Scan tunnel button. The payload was shown as a Mac image because the Herdr pane was 19 columns wide.
checks.camera_during_mirroring: not available; iOS reports that the iPhone camera is not available from Mac
checks.typed_url_and_code_reconnect: passed after a page reload ended the in-memory session
checks.phone_submission: passed for offer, offer cancel, payment, and data note
checks.stale_terminal_typeahead: found; input typed while no review was open answered the next review and denied it. Fixed: each review now discards earlier input. After the fix, a double Enter denial left the next review open.

website_approval_run.device: desktop Chromium (agent-browser), public Quick Tunnels on ports 8797 and 8798
website_approval_run.flow: connect with URL and code, select key, build payment, review in page, select Sign, 1Password signs, demo verifies, submit

checks.in_page_review_shows_decoded_fields: passed; source, fee, sequence, memo, time bounds, destination, asset, amount
checks.discard_sends_nothing_to_the_tunnel: passed; the tunnel log did not change
checks.1password_agent_error: observed on the first attempt (hash 5a9eb554…950e, not on the ledger) while the 1Password prompt was on another desktop. The owner assigned 1Password to all desktops, and the retry signed.
